english.title: Carry on business of company with intent to defraud creditors / for other fraudulent purpose
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), where the business of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY THE COMPANY..), is carried on

(A)_[with intent to defraud creditors of the company,]_
(B)_[with intent to defraud creditors of another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),]_
(C)_[for a fraudulent purpose, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PURPOSE..),]_

you were knowingly a party to the carrying on of the business in that manner, in that **(..SPECIFY WRONGDOING..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 993 of the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
business of a company is carried on
with intent to defraud creditors of the company / creditors of another person / for a fraudulent purpose
the defendant was knowingly a party to the carrying on of the business in that manner

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Twelve months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
